text.en:
Item (g), for the Province of Cebu, page 205, paragraph f, Title M, section one of Republic Act Numbered Twenty hundred ninety-three is amended to read as follows:
"(g1) Kalangyawon Barrio School, Carcar Construction of 1-room school building ₱4,000.00 "(g2) Bolinawan Primary School, Carcar Completion, repair and painting 3,500.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
